arxiv-2005-07461.title: Factors in the Portability of Tokenized Assets on Distributed Ledgers
arxiv-2005-07461.creator: Richard Barnes
arxiv-2005-07461.description: Abstract The tokenization of assets deployed to distributed ledger technology is increasingly cited to revolutionize financial services by allowing traditionally illiquid assets to be bought and sold on primary and secondary markets increasing asset liquidity, transparency and reducing transaction completion time.

arxiv-2011-12947.title: Secure GDoF of the Z Z -channel with Finite Precision CSIT: How Robust are Structured Codes?
arxiv-2011-12947.creator: Yao-Chia Chan, Syed A. Jafar
arxiv-2011-12947.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Yao-Chia Chan, Syed A. Jafar. Under the assumption of perfect channel state information at the transmitters (CSIT), it is known that structured codes offer significant advantages for secure communication in an interference network, e.g., structured jamming signals based on lattice codes may allow a receiver to decode the sum of the jamming signal and the signal being jammed, even though they cannot be separately resolved due to secrecy constraints, subtract the aggregate jammed signal, and then proceed to decode desired codewords at lower power

arxiv-2202-04803.title: Magnetic excitations in double perovskite iridates La 2 M \mathit{M} IrO 6 ( M \mathit{M} = Co, Ni, and Zn) mediated by 3 d \mathit{d} -5 d \mathit{d} hybridization
arxiv-2202-04803.creator: Wentao Jin, Sae Hwan Chun, Jungho Kim, Diego Casa, Jacob P. C. Ruff, C. J. Won, K. D. Lee, N. Hur, Young-June Kim
arxiv-2202-04803.description: Abstract By performing resonant inelastic x-ray scattering (RIXS) measurements at the Ir L 3 \mathit{L_{\mathrm{3}}} edge, we have investigated the low-energy elementary excitations in a series of double perovskite iridate single crystals, La 2 M \mathit{M} IrO 6 ( M \mathit{M} = Co, Ni, and Zn).

arxiv-2210-14591.title: Patterning of superconducting two-dimensional electron gases based on AlO x /KTaO 3 (111) interfaces
arxiv-2210-14591.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by . The versatility of properties displayed by two-dimensional electron gases (2DEGs) at oxide interfaces has fostered intense research in hope of achieving exotic electromagnetic effects in confined systems. Of particular interest is the recently discovered superconducting state appearing in (111)-oriented KTaO 3 interfaces, with a critical temperature T c ≈ 2 \approx 2 K, almost ten times higher than that of SrTiO 3 -based 2DEGs.

arxiv-2211-03385.title: Consistency and asymptotic normality in a class of nearly unstable processes
arxiv-2211-03385.creator: Marie Badreau, Frédéric Proïa
arxiv-2211-03385.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Marie Badreau, Frédéric Proïa. This paper deals with inference in a class of stable but nearly-unstable processes. Autoregressive processes are considered, in which the bridge between stability and instability is expressed by a time-varying companion matrix A n A_{n} with spectral radius ρ ⁡ ( A n ) < 1 \rho(A_{n})<1 satisfying ρ ⁡ ( A n ) → 1 \rho(A_{n})\rightarrow 1 . This framework is particularly suitable to understand unit root issues by focusing on the inner boundary of the unit circle.

arxiv-2310-01949.title: Scaling Methods for Stochastic Chemical Reaction Networks Thanks: 1 Supported by PhD grant of ENS-PSL
arxiv-2310-01949.creator: Lucie Laurence 1, Philippe Robert
arxiv-2310-01949.description: Abstract . We investigate the asymptotic properties of Markov processes associated to stochastic chemical reaction networks (CRNs) driven by the kinetics of the law of mass action. Their transition rates exhibit a polynomial dependence on the state variable, with possible discontinuities of the dynamics along the boundary of the state space.

arxiv-2310-12039.title: Ordered Reliability Direct Error Pattern Testing Decoding Algorithm
arxiv-2310-12039.creator: Reza Hadavian, Xiaoting Huang, Dmitri Truhachev, Kamal El-Sankary, Hamid Ebrahimzad, Hossein Najafi
arxiv-2310-12039.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Reza Hadavian, Xiaoting Huang, Dmitri Truhachev, Kamal El-Sankary, Hamid Ebrahimzad, Hossein Najafi. We introduce a novel universal soft-decision decoding algorithm for binary block codes called ordered reliability direct error pattern testing (ORDEPT). Our results, obtained for a variety of popular short high-rate codes, demonstrate that ORDEPT outperforms state-of-the-art decoding algorithms of comparable complexity such as ordered reliability bits guessing random additive noise decoding (ORBGRAND) in terms of the decoding error probability and latency.

arxiv-2410-13062.title: Exploring Quantum Materials with Resonant Inelastic X-Ray Scattering
arxiv-2410-13062.creator: M. Mitrano, S. Johnston, Young-June Kim, M. P. M. Dean
arxiv-2410-13062.description: Abstract Understanding quantum materials — solids in which quantum-mechanical interactions among constituent electrons yield a great variety of novel emergent phenomena — is a forefront challenge in modern condensed matter physics. This goal has driven the invention and refinement of several experimental methods, which can spectroscopically determine the elementary excitations and correlation functions that determine material properties.

arxiv-2503-01468.title: Overcoming Non-stationary Dynamics with Evidential Proximal Policy Optimization
arxiv-2503-01468.creator: Abdullah Akgül akgul@imada.sdu.dk, Gulcin Baykal baykalg@imada.sdu.dk, Manuel Haußmann haussmann@imada.sdu.dk, Melih Kandemir kandemir@imada.sdu.dk
arxiv-2503-01468.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Abdullah Akgül akgul@imada.sdu.dk, Gulcin Baykal baykalg@imada.sdu.dk, Manuel Haußmann haussmann@imada.sdu.dk, Melih Kandemir kandemir@imada.sdu.dk. Continuous control of non-stationary environments is a major challenge for deep reinforcement learning algorithms. The time-dependency of the state transition dynamics aggravates the notorious stability problems of model-free deep actor-critic architectures. We posit that two properties will play a key role in overcoming non-stationarity in transition dynamics: (i) preserving the plasticity of the critic network and (ii) directed exploration for rapid adaptation to changing dynamics.

arxiv-2510-24528.title: From Cross-Task Examples to In-Task Prompts: A Graph-Based Pseudo-Labeling Framework for In-context Learning
arxiv-2510-24528.creator: Zihan Chen, Song Wang, Xingbo Fu, Chengshuai Shi, Zhenyu Lei, Cong Shen, Jundong Li
arxiv-2510-24528.description: Abstract The capability of in-context learning (ICL) enables large language models (LLMs) to perform novel tasks without parameter updates by conditioning on a few input-output examples. However, collecting high-quality examples for new or challenging tasks can be costly and labor-intensive. In this work, we propose a cost-efficient two-stage pipeline that reduces reliance on LLMs for data labeling.

arxiv-2511-19684.title: IndEgo: A Dataset of Ind ustrial Scenarios and Collaborative Work for Ego centric Assistants
arxiv-2511-19684.creator: Vivek Chavan, Yasmina Imgrund, Tung Dao, Sanwantri Bai, Bosong Wang, Ze Lu, Oliver Heimann, Jörg Krüger, [0.75em] Fraunhofer IPK, Berlin
arxiv-2511-19684.description: Abstract We introduce IndEgo, a multimodal egocentric and exocentric dataset addressing common industrial tasks, including assembly/disassembly, logistics and organisation, inspection and repair, woodworking, and others. The dataset contains 3,460 egocentric recordings (approximately 197 hours), along with 1,092 exocentric recordings (approximately 97 hours).

pmc-10645284.title: Serial Changes in Intestinal Stenotic Stiffness in Patients with Crohn’s Disease Treated with Biologics: A Pilot Study Using Ultrasound Shear Wave Elastography
pmc-10645284.creator: Hiroshi Matsumoto, Jiro Hata, Hiroshi Imuamura, Shogen Yo, Momoyo Sasahira, Hiraku Misawa, Motoyasu Oosawa, Osamu Handa, Eiji Umegami, Akiko Shiotani
pmc-10645284.description: Background/Aims:Intestinal strictures represent an important serious complication of Crohn’s disease. Shear wave elastography is a promising noninvasive ultrasound technique for assessing tissue stiffness. This study aimed to evaluate stiffness in the areas of intestinal stricture in patients with Crohn’s disease using shear wave elastography and the changes in stiffness after biologics.

pmc-11421146.title: Emergence and transmission of the high-risk ST78 clone of OXA-48-producing Enterobacter hormaechei in a single hospital in Taiwan
pmc-11421146.creator: Chih-Ming Chen, Hui-Ling Tang, Ying-Tsong Chen, Se-Chin Ke, Yi-Pei Lin, Bo-Han Chen, Ru-Hsiou Teng, Chien-Shun Chiou, Min-Chi Lu, Yi-Chyi Lai
pmc-11421146.description: Carbapenem-resistant Enterobacter cloacae complex is a significant global healthcare threat, particularly carbapenemase-producing Enterobacter hormaechei (CPEH). From January 2017 to January 2021, twenty-two CPEH isolates from a regional teaching hospital in central Taiwan were identified with the carriage of carbapenemase genes blaKPC-2, blaIMP-8, and predominantly blaOXA-48.

pmc-11556132.title: Draft genome sequence of Sanguibacter species strain 25GB23B1, cultivated from arctic surface seawater
pmc-11556132.creator: Kiana Mitchell, Grace Busch, Indu Sharma
pmc-11556132.description: We report a draft genome sequence for Sanguibacter species strain 25GB23B1, isolated from arctic surface seawater off the coast of Alaska. The whole genome sequence will provide knowledge of the bacteria’s relationship to its environment and possibly a new species of Sanguibacter. ANNOUNCEMENT Sanguibacter is a genus of Gram-positive, coryneform bacteria under the family of Cellulomonadaceae.

pmc-11603131.title: Proteasome associated function of UCH37 is evolutionarily conserved in Plasmodium parasites
pmc-11603131.creator: Mohsen Hajisadeghian, Annie M Geiger, Carla Briggs, Cameron Smith, Katerina Artavanis-Tsakonas
pmc-11603131.description: Ubiquitin C-terminal hydrolase 37 (UCH37 also known as UCHL5) is a conserved deubiquitinating enzyme (DUB) with dual roles in proteasomal degradation and chromatin remodeling in humans. Its Plasmodium falciparum ortholog, PfUCH37, is unusual in that it possesses both DUB and deneddylating activities.

pmc-12475401.title: Salvage of buccal mucosa graft pyeloplasty in kidney transplantation: A case report
pmc-12475401.creator: O. Decombe, A. Manuguerra, A. Blondeau, C. Larose, A. Flahault, C. Mazeaud
pmc-12475401.description: We report the first successful use of a buccal mucosa graft for pyelo-ureteral fistula repair in a renal transplant recipient under immunosuppressive therapy.A 73-year-old male developed a urinary fistula following kidney transplantation. Surgical revision revealed a 2-cm anterior wall defect, which was repaired using an onlay buccal mucosa graft and omental flap.

pmc-13193195.creator: Jadson Stheferson Dutra Alves, Leandro de Araújo Pernambuco, Hipólito Virgilio Magalhães, Jadson Stheferson Dutra Alves, Leandro de Araújo Pernambuco, Hipólito Virgilio Magalhães
pmc-13193195.description: PurposeTo develop and verify content validity evidence of DEGLUTO, a clinical swallowing assessment instrument for adults.MethodsA cross-sectional methodological study.
